# Motel One

> > Budget design hotels across Europe offering stylish accommodations at affordable prices with beOne membership benefits

Motel One operates design-focused budget hotels in major European cities including München, Wien, Leipzig, Amsterdam, Bonn, Nürnberg, and Paris. The brand emphasizes contemporary interior design, city-center locations, and digital convenience through the beOne membership app with features like Mobile Key and Quick Check-in.

## Hotel Locations

- [Hotel München Deutsches Museum](https://www.motel-one.com/de/hotels/muenchen/hotel-muenchen-deutsches-museum): Munich hotel near Deutsches Museum and Viktualienmarkt
- [Hotel Wien Hauptbahnhof](https://www.motel-one.com/de/hotels/wien/hotel-wien-hauptbahnhof): Vienna Hauptbahnhof hotel near city center with design rooms
- [Hotel Wien Prater](https://www.motel-one.com/de/hotels/wien/hotel-wien-prater): Vienna Prater hotel near Praterstern and exhibition center
- [Hotel Nürnberg City](https://www.motel-one.com/de/hotels/nuernberg/hotel-nuernberg-city): Nuremberg city center hotel near Hauptbahnhof and Christkindlmarkt
- [Hotel Bonn Hauptbahnhof](https://www.motel-one.com/de/hotels/bonn/hotel-bonn-hauptbahnhof): Bonn Hauptbahnhof hotel near city center with design rooms

## beOne Membership & Services

- [beOne App](https://www.motel-one.com/de/services/be-one-membership/be-one-app): beOne membership app for bookings, deals, and mobile key access
- [Quick Check-in & Mobile Key](https://www.motel-one.com/de/services/be-one-membership/quick-check-in-mobile-key): Digital check-in and smartphone room access via beOne app
- [Zimmerkategorien](https://www.motel-one.com/de/services/zimmerkategorien): Room categories and amenities at Motel One hotels
- [FAQ](https://www.motel-one.com/en/services/faq): Frequently asked questions about bookings, services, and beOne program
- [About You Partnership](https://www.motel-one.com/de/services/about-you): About You partnership with 20% discount promo code for hotels
